keyboard_observations: At minimum 175%, native Ctrl+O from nonempty REPORT-03 opened patient search while the committed header remained SYNTH-001. Native Escape returned to the Results filter with a visible caret, reloaded four rows, and left selection and document empty.

Native click selected MORGAN / SYNTH-003 and a settled UIA table name included that ID. Native Down selected the other MORGAN and the table name/preview changed to SYNTH-004 while no chart was committed. Native double-click then opened CARTER / SYNTH-001.

At ordinary native-launch 100%, native selection/Enter opened SYNTH-001 / PROB-01 with focus in the read-only Cover Sheet text (not Close). Ctrl+A selected 343 characters including the patient/item identities. Escape restored the originating Problem List table, and Down immediately selected the Beta item.

Notes: native Enter from filter and Down selected NOTE-01 and automatically requested text. Enter focused its read-only pane with SYNTH-001 / NOTE-01 in the UIA name/value. Escape retained text; a subsequent Down selected NOTE-02, demonstrating actual list focus. Ctrl+F focused the Notes filter; Ctrl+O then Escape cleared text/selection and restored the Notes filter for the same committed patient.

Orders: native Enter/Down selected ORDER-01 with an identity-bearing table/document name and no document value. A second Enter focused read-only text; Ctrl+A selected 382 characters identifying SYNTH-001 / ORDER-01. Escape cleared text while retaining the row.

Results: native Enter/Down selected REPORT-01 with no document value before activation. A second Enter focused the reading pane. After its real delayed value settled, Ctrl+A selected 422 characters identifying SYNTH-001 / REPORT-01. Escape closed it while retaining selection. An earlier Ctrl+A before the delayed value arrived did not establish text selection and was repeated only after the value was observed.
After closing Orders, a settled capture had no document value; native Down changed selection to ORDER-02 with no automatic retrieval.
uia_limits: An immediate capture after selecting a patient still said No patient selected; a fresh capture exposed the correct selected identity. Reobserve before judging completion; this is not a complete UIA conformance result.
Immediately after Notes Escape the reported focused element still named a filter; a native Down changed the selected note to NOTE-02, demonstrating actual list focus separately from that snapshot.
